sources.title: Antigua and Barbuda Immigration: passports
sources.publisher: Department of Immigration, Government of Antigua and Barbuda
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Immigration Department passport service says Antigua and Barbuda passports are issued to citizens and separately defines adult, minor, diplomatic and official passport types.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Adult Passports – These passports are issued to any adult who is a citizen of Antigua and Barbuda.

sources.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina FIPA: visa information for visitors
sources.publisher: Foreign Investment Promotion Agency of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Foreign Investment Promotion Agency page is published on the Council of Ministers' gov.ba domain and lists Antigua and Barbuda among citizens who do not require a visa.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of the following countries do not require a visa to enter Bosnia and Herzegovina: ... Antigua and Barbuda.

sources.title: Service for Foreigners' Affairs: stay of aliens in Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.publisher: Service for Foreigners' Affairs of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The current competent Service for Foreigners' Affairs guidance says the Decision on Visas determines the visa-free country list and states the statutory visa-free stay limit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa-free aliens may enter and stay up to 90 days over a six-month period.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 Tourism (F5A) visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document defines F5A tourism eligibility for citizens of all countries, its online process, and delivery of a visa certificate by email.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea Government: online visa is operational
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea Information and Press Office
sources.officialityEvidence: The live institutional Government page identifies itself as the Government of Equatorial Guinea and directly confirms that the equatorialguinea-evisa.com portal is operational for visitors to obtain visas online without an in-person visit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: todos los interesados en viajar al país podrán conseguir su visado sin tener que desplazarse físicamente.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: live eligibility and electronic-delivery translation asset
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal's authenticity and online-visa purpose are anchored by the current Government Information and Press Office announcement that directs visitors to this exact domain. Its live English translation asset supplies the all-nationality scope and emailed/PDF issuance mechanics.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Nationalities can apply for an E-Visa ... All E-Visa are sent by email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: live regular-passport translation asset
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal's authenticity is anchored by the live Government announcement linking to this exact service. Its live English translation asset requires the travel passport to match the application and excludes non-regular travel documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The only travel document that can be used ... is your regular passport.

policies.title: Antigua and Barbuda ordinary passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Current Bosnia and Herzegovina government guidance lists Antigua and Barbuda in the general visa-free rule and states an up-to-90-days-in-180-days stay limit.
conditions: Use the regular Antigua and Barbuda citizen passport (adult or minor), not a diplomatic or official passport. Current BiH government guidance lists Antigua and Barbuda as visa-exempt and sets the general visa-free stay at up to 90 days in 180 days.
This does not establish employment, residence, emergency or temporary travel documents, diplomatic or official treatment, identity-document travel, carrier rules or final admission.

policies.title: Antigua and Barbuda ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism route accepts citizens of all countries and sends the tourism visa certificate by email before travel.
conditions: Apply online using a valid regular Antigua and Barbuda citizen passport (adult or minor) with the F5A tourism supporting documents and payment; the visitor route is single entry for up to 30 days.
The emailed visa certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.

Nigeria excepts ECOWAS States and countries with a visa-waiver agreement. The current document does not identify an Antigua and Barbuda regular-passport waiver; the all-country eVisa route is retained with medium confidence. Diplomatic, official, emergency, temporary and other special documents, work, residence, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service tourism eVisa
steps: Apply online with the Antigua and Barbuda regular passport and stated tourism documents.
Pay and receive the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present the certificate and supporting documents for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Antigua and Barbuda ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's authenticated live eVisa service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email as a PDF before travel.
conditions: Use the same regular Antigua and Barbuda citizen passport (adult or minor) for application and travel; non-regular travel documents are not accepted.
Apply through the authenticated eVisa service and receive the eVisa by email in PDF form before travel. The arrival immigration process does not alter the pre-travel electronic issuance.
The ordinary visitor route does not establish work, residence, diplomatic, official, emergency, temporary, carrier or final-admission entitlement.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea eVisa service
steps: Apply online using the regular Antigua and Barbuda passport for travel.
Receive and retain the emailed PDF eVisa before departure.
Present the same passport and eVisa at arrival for immigration processing and final admission.
